name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 10 – Am 8
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 10. Welcomes the Commission’s proposal for an enhanced Flexibility Instrument and calls for it to be supplemented by additional sources including unspent margins and reflows from financial instruments, without prejudice to sector-specific rules; calls for a dedicated solidarity reserve for natural disasters to be mobilised over and above the MFF ceilings as a last resort to finance the Union’s response to specific needs within the EU following damage caused by natural disasters; further notes that economically weaker regions disproportionately affected by natural disasters should receive tailored support to enable rapid recovery and preserve territorial cohesion;
